rule: Walk reps 11, 12, ... (rep-major, tasks in bench/tasks.yaml order) with seed string '42:<task>:<rep>' and keep the first 20 (task, rep) pairs whose first drawn entry under profiles/paper_opp_scoped.yaml (chaosmonkey.proxy.first_draw) is OP4/permanent, whose one-tool target (bench.arena.pick_target) has a fallback in profiles/shim.yaml, and whose target is on-path: it appears in the proxy logs of every clean run with rep 1-10 of that task in results/runs.jsonl. Applied to reps 1-10 the rule gives the original 10-seed slice. It depends only on seed strings, profiles and clean-run records, never on a chaos run outcome.
